summary: Full code review of WP-001 through WP-004 artifacts: FetchCache.php, FetchCacheTests.php, Fetcher.php, and Comic::getCacheFolder(). All four debt issues are correctly resolved. put() guard is exception-before-manifest-update ordering is correct. get() signature is clean (no unused $url param). isValid() checks disk file existence. ERROR_WRITE_FAILED constant uses correct YYMMNN format. Test coverage is complete and well-structured. PHPStan and PHPUnit both pass.

comments.note: FetchCache::put() calls new WebcomicsBuilderException(message, '', self::ERROR_WRITE_FAILED) with an empty-string $details argument rather than null. BaseException accepts ?string $details so this is functionally correct, but null would be more idiomatic and avoids appending an empty line to the message in test-suite mode.
No other observations — code is clean, consistent, and follows all project conventions.
